svg.text: A226 -- Proposition CROWD-ABOVE: from a record with a corner DOMINO at every corner, a packing at every larger side with all four corner boxes doubly met (red = the eight meeters); STUCK(n) for ALL packings below ceil(sqrt n) is false.
check: 29 squares in [0,S]^2, min SAT gap -1.4e-12; meeters per corner BL BR TR TL = 2 2 2 2
BL corner zoomed (window [0, 2.4]^2): meeters #0 depth 0.9835, #1 depth 0.0000
A slid up by eps = 0.0165; B tilted by eps/2 = 0.474 deg, its vertex pokes into the strip under A; the corner point is bare
